item.title: So I Watched Sore: a Wife From the Future — A cozy romantic madness
item.description:
(This review may contains some spoilers, still this review won’t spoil the experience you have watching the movie.)

I recently watched Sore: a Wife from the future movie. I heard a lot of hype around the movie, so I decided to watch it. It is a kind of unique experience, where a have a warm feeling about the wholesome romance going on, while containing some of the core ideas about life. It reflects on acceptance, forgiveness, moving on, trauma and how changes should come from within.
